verdict.rationale: Controlling whether user data trains AI models is a fair privacy question for a cloud-hosted AI agent service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, data-retention controls, or a no-training policy. The docs cover MCP integration, the sandbox, connectors and analytics, and the community comments discuss local versus cloud architecture rather than training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
